# generate-openapi — OpenAPI 3.1 Schema Generation Skill

Generate production-ready OpenAPI 3.1 YAML specifications from Linear issue
requirements using the `OpenApiGenerator` class. Produce resource-oriented REST
API schemas with consistent error handling, authentication, and pagination.

## Generator Interface

```
Module  : src/uptempo/schema/openapi.py
Class   : OpenApiGenerator(SchemaGenerator)
Methods :
  generate(issue: Issue, workspace: Path) -> list[Path]
  validate(files: list[Path]) -> list[str]
```

## Input

| Field | Source | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `issue.identifier` | Linear | Issue ID (e.g., `UPT-42`) — embedded in header comment |
| `issue.title` | Linear | Short summary — becomes `info.title` seed |
| `issue.description` | Linear | Full requirements — parse for resources, fields, auth |
| `workspace` | Orchestrator | Absolute path to `./workspaces/{issue_id}/` |

## Output

```
{workspace}/
└── openapi/
    ├── {domain}-api.yaml        # Primary spec
    ├── components/
    │   ├── schemas.yaml         # Reusable data models
    │   ├── parameters.yaml      # Shared query/path params
    │   └── security-schemes.yaml
    └── .spectral.yaml           # Lint ruleset (if absent)
```

All YAML files use OpenAPI 3.1.0 and include the standard header comment:

```yaml
# Generated by Uptempo for UPT-42: Order Management API
```

## Procedure

### Step 1 — Parse Requirements

1. Extract resource nouns from `issue.description` (e.g., "orders", "users").
2. Identify relationships: one-to-many (`/users/{userId}/orders`), many-to-many.
3. Detect authentication keywords: "OAuth", "JWT", "API key", "bearer", "token".
4. Detect pagination keywords: "cursor", "offset", "page", "limit", "next".
5. Note versioning hints: "v1", "v2", "versioned", "breaking change".

### Step 2 — Initialize Workspace

```python
from uptempo.schema.openapi import OpenApiGenerator

generator = OpenApiGenerator()
out_dir = workspace / "openapi"
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

### Step 3 — Build Spec Structure

Construct the root document following this skeleton:

```yaml
openapi: "3.1.0"
info:
  title: "{Domain} API"
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: "Generated from Linear issue {issue.identifier}"
  contact:
    name: "uptempo"
servers:
  - url: /api/v1
    description: "Primary"
paths: {}
components:
  schemas: {}
  parameters: {}
  responses: {}
  securitySchemes: {}
```

### Step 4 — Generate Resource Paths

For each identified resource, produce the five standard CRUD operations:

| Method | Path | operationId | Success |
|--------|------|-------------|---------|
| GET | `/{resources}` | `list{Resources}` | 200 |
| GET | `/{resources}/{id}` | `get{Resource}ById` | 200 |
| POST | `/{resources}` | `create{Resource}` | 201 |
| PATCH | `/{resources}/{id}` | `update{Resource}` | 200 |
| DELETE | `/{resources}/{id}` | `delete{Resource}` | 204 |

Apply these rules:
- Resource names are plural nouns, lowercase, kebab-case for multi-word.
- Every operation has a unique `operationId`.
- Every path parameter uses `format: uuid` unless the issue specifies otherwise.
- Tag operations by resource name.

### Step 5 — Define Component Schemas

For each resource, generate:

```yaml
components:
  schemas:
    Order:
      type: object
      required: [id, createdAt]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updatedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    OrderCreate:
      description: "Request body for POST /{resources}"
      type: object
      required: []  # populated from issue

    OrderUpdate:
      description: "Request body for PATCH /{resources}/{id}"
      type: object
```

### Step 6 — Add Error Responses (RFC 7807)

Include the shared ProblemDetail schema and wire it to every error response:

```yaml
components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      type: object
      required: [type, title, status]
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          format: uri
        title:
          type: string
        status:
          type: integer
        detail:
          type: string
        instance:
          type: string
          format: uri

  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: "Validation error"
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    NotFound:
      description: "Resource not found"
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    Unauthorized:
      description: "Authentication required"
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
```

### Step 7 — Add Pagination

Apply cursor-based pagination to all `list*` operations by default:

```yaml
components:
  parameters:
    CursorParam:
      name: cursor
      in: query
      schema:
        type: string
    LimitParam:
      name: limit
      in: query
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        maximum: 100
        default: 20

  schemas:
    PaginationMeta:
      type: object
      properties:
        hasNextPage:
          type: boolean
        endCursor:
          type: string
        totalCount:
          type: integer
```

### Step 8 — Add Security Schemes

Select schemes based on issue keywords. Default to Bearer JWT when unspecified:

```yaml
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
    apiKey:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-API-Key
    oauth2:
      type: oauth2
      flows:
        authorizationCode:
          authorizationUrl: /oauth/authorize
          tokenUrl: /oauth/token
          scopes: {}

security:
  - bearerAuth: []
```

### Step 9 — Write Files

```python
files = generator.generate(issue, workspace)
# Returns list of Path objects for all created YAML files
```

### Step 10 — Validate

```python
errors = generator.validate(files)
# Runs Spectral lint against each file
# Returns empty list on success
```

## Output Template

Minimal valid single-resource spec:

```yaml
openapi: "3.1.0"
info:
  title: "Orders API"
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: "Generated from Linear issue UPT-42"
servers:
  - url: /api/v1
paths:
  /orders:
    get:
      operationId: listOrders
      tags: [orders]
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CursorParam'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/LimitParam'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "Paginated list"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  data:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/components/schemas/Order'
                  meta:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/PaginationMeta'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/Unauthorized'
    post:
      operationId: createOrder
      tags: [orders]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OrderCreate'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: "Created"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Order'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /orders/{orderId}:
    parameters:
      - name: orderId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          format: uuid
    get:
      operationId: getOrderById
      tags: [orders]
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "Order details"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Order'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
components:
  schemas:
    Order:
      type: object
      required: [id, status, createdAt]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [pending, confirmed, shipped, delivered, cancelled]
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    OrderCreate:
      type: object
      required: [items]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
    PaginationMeta:
      type: object
      properties:
        hasNextPage:
          type: boolean
        endCursor:
          type: string
    ProblemDetail:
      type: object
      required: [type, title, status]
      properties:
        type: { type: string, format: uri }
        title: { type: string }
        status: { type: integer }
        detail: { type: string }
  parameters:
    CursorParam:
      name: cursor
      in: query
      schema: { type: string }
    LimitParam:
      name: limit
      in: query
      schema: { type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 100, default: 20 }
  responses:
    BadRequest:
      description: "Validation error"
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    NotFound:
      description: "Resource not found"
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    Unauthorized:
      description: "Missing or invalid credentials"
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
security:
  - bearerAuth: []
```

## Validation Rules

| Rule | Tool | Severity |
|------|------|----------|
| Valid OpenAPI 3.1 structure | Spectral `oas` ruleset | error |
| Every operation has `operationId` | Spectral `operation-operationId` | error |
| No unused components | Spectral `oas3-unused-component` | warn |
| Descriptions on all schemas | Spectral `oas3-valid-schema-example` | warn |
| RFC 7807 on 4xx/5xx responses | custom `uptempo-rfc7807` rule | error |
| `$ref` targets resolve | Spectral built-in | error |
| Header comment present | `_header_comment()` check | error |

Run validation:

```bash
npx @stoplight/spectral-cli lint {workspace}/openapi/*.yaml --ruleset .spectral.yaml
```

## Error Handling

| Condition | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| No resources found in issue | Generate placeholder CRUD for `items` resource with `x-generated: placeholder` |
| Conflicting path definitions | Include both with `x-conflict: true` and resolution comment |
| Missing field types | Infer from field name (`*Id` → `uuid`, `*At` → `date-time`, `*Count` → `integer`) |
| Ambiguous auth requirement | Default to Bearer JWT, add `x-auth-inferred: true` |
| Spectral lint failure | Return errors from `validate()`, do not delete generated files |
| Workspace directory missing | Create `openapi/` directory tree automatically |
